source_status.exact_result: For each fixed rational-coefficient continuous actual-PC positive-at-infinity reference on the product of two nonempty finite embedded balanced rational pure graphs with actual positive real edge weights and rank-one local nonnegative relation cones containing the strictly positive actual vector, every bounded continuous real-PA obstacle has a rational-domain PAPC uniformly decreasingly regularizable raw envelope with full contact if and only if at least one factor is unbranched. If both branch, every prescribed such reference has a nonnegative bounded compactly supported rational-PA obstacle with exact raw envelope P=max(gamma,epsilon H+C) and complete integral -8 epsilon^2 ab<0. All bounded edges, cycles, ends, full lines, disconnected components and actual saturated lattices are retained.
concrete_gaps: Original P05.2: arbitrary balanced rational spaces and fixed-pair classification outside the specified two-graph product subclass remain open.

For two branched factors, extension from every fixed rational-coefficient reference to every real-coefficient reference on rational spatial domains is unproved: the max comparison walls may be irrational, and no rational-domain PAPC regularization/envelope substitute has been established.
The catalogue intrinsic-smoothness/strict-positivity contact package is not classified here. No literal-category, extra affine-factor, analytic-realization, P05.5 or P06.2 result is claimed.
Author self-audit and finite executions are not independent mathematical certification. The whole proof remains an unverified draft.
